blocks.title: Launch token
blocks.blurb: Standard IMD token: 1B supply, no owner.
blocks.sentence: Token: {name} ({symbol}), the standard launch token: 1,000,000,000 supply, 18 decimals, plain transfers, no owner functions.

blocks.title: Bring your own token
blocks.blurb: Your name, symbol, supply and decimals.
blocks.sentence: Token: my own token {name} ({symbol}), supply {supply:n}, {dec} decimals, minted once to the launch factory, no transfer fee, nothing minted after launch, no privileged address can move, freeze, pause or seize a holder’s tokens, with a public burn(uint256) that burns the caller's own tokens. The supply is capped at 1,000,000,000,000 tokens.

blocks.title: Swap fee
blocks.blurb: A fixed cut of every swap, sent somewhere.
blocks.sentence: Take {rate:1}% of the {@pair} side of every {applies} as a hook fee, settled in {@pair} inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly), and {@destination}. Expose claimFees(PoolId poolId) that anyone may call to redeem that pool's claims using the same distribution. {@feeBasis}

anyone.label: Send collected fees to the recipient

blocks.who: Runs itself; fees reach the recipient automatically.

blocks.title: Fee that fades
blocks.blurb: Starts high at launch, settles to a floor.
blocks.sentence: Replace only the Swap fee block's rate schedule, for the same {@feeApplies} swaps: the rate starts at {start:1}% at the pool's first swap and decreases linearly over {mins} minutes of block timestamp to the Swap fee's {@baseRate}%, then stays there. It uses the Swap fee's recipient and distribution, settled in {@pair}; if Volatility fee also applies, the higher rate wins. Track the first-swap time separately by PoolId. Expose currentFeeBps(PoolId poolId) as a view. {@feeBasis}

blocks.title: Different buy and sell fees
blocks.blurb: One rate for buys, another for sells.
blocks.sentence: Take {buy:1}% of the {@pair} side of every buy and {sell:1}% of the {@pair} side of every sell as a hook fee, settled in {@pair} inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly), and {@destination}. Expose claimFees(PoolId poolId) that anyone may call to redeem that pool's claims using the same distribution. {@feeBasis}

anyone.label: Send collected fees to the recipient

blocks.title: Whale fee
blocks.blurb: Big swaps pay an extra fee.
blocks.sentence: Any swap whose {@pair} side actually traded is larger than {above} {@pair} pays an extra {extra:1}% of its {@pair} side as a hook fee, on top of the Swap fee or Different buy and sell fees, settled in {@pair} inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly), using that fee block's recipient and distribution. The threshold and limits are tracked separately by PoolId. {@feeBasis}

blocks.title: Volatility fee
blocks.blurb: Fee rises when the price moves fast.
blocks.sentence: When the absolute pool price move over the last {secs} seconds of block timestamp exceeds {move:1}%, replace the Swap fee's rate with {fee:1}% for the same {@feeApplies} swaps, using the Swap fee's recipient and distribution, settled in {@pair}. Otherwise use the Swap fee's rate schedule. If Fee that fades also applies, the higher rate wins. Track price history and volatility separately by PoolId. Expose isVolatile(PoolId poolId) as a view. {@feeBasis}

view.label: Whether the raised fee applies now

blocks.title: Split the fee
blocks.blurb: Send the hook fee to two places.
blocks.sentence: Replace the Swap fee's destination: split the Swap fee and Whale fee only, settled in {@pair}, {a}% to {@wallet} and {a:rest}% to {b}. Apply Share fees with LPs first, then split only the remaining recipient fee. Never split the Buyback jar or Prize pot.

blocks.title: Dynamic LP fee
blocks.blurb: The pool’s own fee tier moves with volatility. Own pools only.
blocks.sentence: The pool must be initialized with the dynamic-fee flag (fee 0x800000). The fee moves linearly with the absolute price move over the last {secs} seconds of block timestamp: {lo}% at zero move and {hi}% at a move of {move}% or greater, capped at {hi}%. Track the price history and dynamic LP fee separately by PoolId. Expose currentLpFee(PoolId poolId) as a view.
blocks.who: Runs itself; sets the pool fee each swap.

blocks.title: Anti-sniper window
blocks.blurb: Cap what one wallet can buy right after launch.
blocks.sentence: For the first {mins} minutes of block timestamp after the pool's first swap, each wallet may buy at most {pct:1}% of the token's total supply in total; larger buys revert. Track the window and each wallet's bought total separately by PoolId. Expose windowEndsAt(PoolId poolId) as a view. {@walletLimit}
blocks.risk: Per-wallet limits can be sidestepped by splitting across several wallets.
blocks.who: Runs itself for the window, then switches off.

blocks.title: Max buy per wallet
blocks.blurb: A permanent cap on what one wallet can buy.
blocks.short: max {pct:1}% of supply per wallet, ever
blocks.sentence: Each wallet may buy at most {pct:1}% of the token's total supply through this pool in total, for the life of the pool; larger buys revert. Sells are never blocked. Track each wallet's bought total separately by PoolId. Expose boughtBy(PoolId poolId, address wallet) as a view. {@walletLimit}

view.label: How much a wallet has bought

blocks.risk: Per-wallet limits can be sidestepped by splitting across several wallets.

blocks.title: Max swap size
blocks.blurb: Reject any single swap above a size.
blocks.sentence: When the swapper specifies a token amount, reject any single swap whose specified amount exceeds {tokens:n} {@symbol} in the token's own decimals, in either direction. Swaps that specify the {@pair} pair-currency amount are not capped by this rule. Apply the limit separately by PoolId.
blocks.risk: A trader can split one large trade into several smaller ones.

blocks.title: Anti-sandwich
blocks.blurb: Stop sandwich attacks within a block.
blocks.sentence: Within one block, no swap executes at a better price than the block's opening price in its own direction; the difference the cap withholds is donated to the pool's liquidity providers through the PoolManager's donate, never to the fee recipient or the owner. Track each opening price separately by PoolId, using the chain's own block number (ArbSys(address(100)).arbBlockNumber() on Robinhood Chain).

blocks.title: Cooldown
blocks.blurb: Make a wallet wait between swaps.
blocks.sentence: A wallet must wait at least {secs} seconds of block timestamp between its swaps in this pool. Track each wallet's next swap time separately by PoolId. Expose nextSwapAt(PoolId poolId, address wallet) as a view. {@walletLimit}

view.label: When a wallet may swap again

blocks.risk: Per-wallet limits can be sidestepped by splitting across several wallets.

blocks.title: Circuit breaker
blocks.blurb: Pause trading briefly after a violent move.
blocks.sentence: If the absolute pool price move over the last {secs} seconds of block timestamp exceeds {move}%, reject every swap for the next {pause} minutes of block timestamp, then resume automatically. Liquidity can still be removed during the pause. Track price history and the pause separately by PoolId. Expose haltedUntil(PoolId poolId) as a view.
blocks.risk: A large trader can trip the breaker on purpose to stall trading for everyone.

blocks.title: Buyback jar
blocks.blurb: Collect a cut, then buy your token with it.
blocks.short: {rate:1}% into a jar, buy back at {trig} {@pair}
blocks.sentence: Collect {rate:1}% of the {@pair} side of every swap into a jar held by the hook, tracked separately by PoolId and settled in {@pair} inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly). When the jar holds at least {trig} {@pair}, anyone may call buyback(PoolId poolId). Buy only inside buyback(), never inside a swap, from this same pool, with a price limit 3% above the pool price at the start of the call; keep any unspent {@pair} in that pool's jar and anyone may call it again. {@jarAction}. Expose jar(PoolId poolId) as a view. {@feeBasis}

anyone.label: Spend the jar when it is full

blocks.who: Runs itself; anyone presses the button when the jar is full.

blocks.title: Share fees with LPs
blocks.blurb: Part of the hook fee goes back to liquidity providers.
blocks.short: {pct}% of the hook fee to LPs
blocks.sentence: Replace the Swap fee's distribution: donate {pct}% of the Swap fee and Whale fee only, settled in {@pair}, back to that PoolId's in-range liquidity providers through the PoolManager's donate, and send the rest to the fee recipient (or split it if Split the fee is selected). If no liquidity is in range, the whole fee goes to the recipient under the same destination, including Split the fee when selected. Apply LP sharing first, then Split the fee; never share the Buyback jar or Prize pot.

blocks.title: Liquidity lock
blocks.blurb: Liquidity cannot be removed for a while.
blocks.sentence: Liquidity added to a position is locked for {days} days of block timestamp from its latest addition; removing it earlier reverts. Zero-change fee collection is always allowed. Key each position by (sender, tickLower, tickUpper, salt), separately by PoolId. The hook's own positions (Limit orders, Yield) are exempt from every liquidity rule. Expose unlockAt(bytes32 positionKey) as a view; positionKey includes PoolId, sender, tickLower, tickUpper and salt.

blocks.title: JIT penalty
blocks.blurb: Punish liquidity that only shows up for one trade.
blocks.sentence: Liquidity removed from a position within {secs} seconds of block timestamp of its latest addition forfeits the fees it earned in that time to the remaining liquidity providers (the LiquidityPenaltyHook pattern). Key each position by (sender, tickLower, tickUpper, salt), separately by PoolId. The hook's own positions (Limit orders, Yield) are exempt from every liquidity rule.

blocks.title: LP allowlist
blocks.blurb: Only listed wallets may add liquidity.
blocks.ownerPower: add and remove liquidity-provider allowlist addresses
blocks.sentence: Only wallets on the owner's liquidity-provider allowlist may add liquidity; this allowlist never restricts removal of their own liquidity. The hook's own positions (Limit orders, Yield) are exempt from every liquidity rule. Track the allowlist separately by PoolId. Expose setLpAllowed(PoolId poolId, address[] accounts, bool allowed) for the owner and isLpAllowed(PoolId poolId, address wallet) as a view. {@walletLimit}

owner.sig: setLpAllowed(PoolId poolId, address[] accounts, bool allowed)
owner.label: Add or remove liquidity providers

view.label: Is a wallet on the list

blocks.who: You (the owner) keep the list up to date.

blocks.title: Minimum position
blocks.blurb: No dust positions.
blocks.sentence: After adding liquidity, the position's total value must be at least {eth} {@pair}, valuing its token leg at this pool's current price and adding its {@pair} leg; otherwise the add reverts. Removing is never blocked by this rule. Key each position by (sender, tickLower, tickUpper, salt), separately by PoolId. The hook's own positions (Limit orders, Yield) are exempt from every liquidity rule.

blocks.title: Scheduled open
blocks.blurb: No trading before a date and time.
blocks.sentence: Reject every swap before {when} UTC. Liquidity may be added before then. Apply the opening time separately by PoolId. Expose opensAt(PoolId poolId) as a view.

blocks.title: Trading hours
blocks.blurb: Only trade during certain hours.
blocks.sentence: Allow swaps only between {from}:00 inclusive and {to}:00 exclusive UTC each day, judged by block timestamp; if the end precedes the start, the interval crosses midnight. Reject all others. Liquidity changes are always allowed. Apply this schedule separately by PoolId. Expose isOpen(PoolId poolId) as a view.

blocks.title: Allowlist opening
blocks.blurb: Only listed wallets may buy at first.
blocks.ownerPower: add and remove buyer allowlist addresses
blocks.sentence: For the first {mins} minutes of block timestamp after the pool's first swap, only wallets on the owner's buyer allowlist may buy; after that, anyone may buy. Track the window and allowlist separately by PoolId. Expose setAllowed(PoolId poolId, address[] accounts, bool allowed) for the owner and isAllowed(PoolId poolId, address wallet) as a view. {@walletLimit}

owner.sig: setAllowed(PoolId poolId, address[] accounts, bool allowed)
owner.label: Add or remove buyers

view.label: Is a wallet on the list

blocks.who: You (the owner) keep the list up to date.

blocks.title: Pause switch
blocks.blurb: The owner can pause swaps. Buyers may dislike it.
blocks.sentence: The owner may pause and unpause swaps separately by PoolId. Liquidity can always be removed while paused. Expose pause(PoolId poolId) and unpause(PoolId poolId) for the owner and paused(PoolId poolId) as a view.

blocks.title: Sunset
blocks.blurb: The hook stops enforcing rules after a date.
blocks.sentence: After {when} UTC every other rule in this request stops applying, wherever it appears, and the hook lets every swap and liquidity change through unchanged, forever. Funds already collected stay withdrawable through their functions. Apply the sunset separately by PoolId. Expose sunsetAt(PoolId poolId) as a view.

blocks.title: Price oracle
blocks.blurb: Other contracts can read a time-weighted price.
blocks.sentence: Record a time-weighted average price of each pool separately by PoolId that other contracts can read (the BaseOracleHook pattern, with a Uniswap v3 compatible observe interface). Expose twap(PoolId poolId, uint32 secondsAgo) as a view returning the average price as a Q64.96 sqrt price.

view.label: The average price over a period

blocks.who: For other contracts and apps: they read the price. Nothing for you to do.

blocks.title: Limit orders
blocks.blurb: Users can place orders that fill at a price.
blocks.sentence: Let users place limit orders in the hook that fill automatically when that PoolId's pool price crosses the order price, and withdraw unfilled orders at any time (the LimitOrderHook pattern). Track orders and liquidity separately by PoolId. Expose placeOrder(PoolId poolId, bool zeroForOne, int24 tick, uint256 amount) returning an id, cancelOrder(PoolId poolId, uint256 id) and claim(PoolId poolId, uint256 id). The hook's own positions are exempt from every liquidity rule.

user.sig: placeOrder(PoolId poolId, bool zeroForOne, int24 tick, uint256 amount)
user.label: Place an order

blocks.who: For traders: they get an order form on your hook page.

blocks.title: Yield on idle liquidity
blocks.blurb: Idle liquidity is lent out to earn yield.
blocks.sentence: The hook holds all liquidity; LPs deposit through the hook; direct adds revert. Liquidity idle at the current price is lent on {proto} and recalled when needed for swaps, tracked separately by PoolId. This block is unavailable until the catalog names the verified deploy-chain Aave v3 Pool address or Morpho Blue market id. Expose rebalance(PoolId poolId) that anyone may call. The hook's own positions are exempt from every liquidity rule.

anyone.label: Move idle liquidity in or out of lending

blocks.who: Runs itself; anyone can press rebalance.

blocks.title: Batch auctions
blocks.blurb: Swaps settle together in batches.
blocks.sentence: Swaps are not filled immediately: the hook collects them and settles each batch at one clearing price every {secs} seconds (the BaseAsyncSwap pattern). Expose settleBatch() that anyone may call once a batch period has ended.
blocks.who: Runs itself; anyone can settle a finished batch.

blocks.title: Stable curve
blocks.blurb: Constant-sum pricing for like-valued assets.
blocks.sentence: Replace each PoolId's pool pricing with a constant-sum curve suited to two assets of the same value (the BaseCustomCurve pattern).

blocks.title: Pool rules
blocks.blurb: Which pools may use this hook.
blocks.sentence: Only pools whose currency0 is native ETH and whose fee tier is {tier}% may be initialized with this hook; any other initialization reverts. Track each pool separately by PoolId.

blocks.title: Donation rules
blocks.blurb: Who may donate to the pool.
blocks.sentence: Only the owner may donate to this PoolId's pool; all other donations revert. The hook's own donations (Share fees with LPs, the anti-sandwich difference) are always allowed. {@walletLimit}

optionSentences.only the owner: Only the owner may donate to this PoolId's pool; all other donations revert. The hook's own donations (Share fees with LPs, the anti-sandwich difference) are always allowed. {@walletLimit}
optionSentences.only allowlisted addresses: Only wallets on the owner's donor allowlist for this PoolId may donate; all other donations revert. Expose setDonor(PoolId poolId, address account, bool allowed) for the owner to maintain that pool's donor allowlist. The hook's own donations (Share fees with LPs, the anti-sandwich difference) are always allowed. {@walletLimit}
optionSentences.nobody: Every donation to this PoolId's pool reverts; this option grants no owner power and exposes no owner function. The hook's own donations (Share fees with LPs, the anti-sandwich difference) are always allowed. {@walletLimit}

owner.sig: setDonor(PoolId poolId, address account, bool allowed)
owner.label: Allow or block a donor

blocks.who: Runs itself; the owner maintains the list only when allowlisted donations are selected.

blocks.title: Prize pot
blocks.blurb: A cut of buys goes to a lucky buyer.
blocks.short: {rate:1}% of buys to a pot, drawn every {hours}h
blocks.sentence: Collect {rate:1}% of the {@pair} side of every buy into that PoolId's prize pot, settled in {@pair} inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly). Periods last {hours} hour(s) of block timestamp, starting at the pool's first swap. Anyone may call draw(PoolId poolId) to settle the most recent complete period: credit the whole pot to one recorded buyer, weighted by the total {@pair} each buyer spent. A period with no buyers rolls its pot into the next period. Use recorded cumulative weighted totals with a bounded winner lookup, never loop over every buyer. The winner withdraws their credit in {@pair} through claimPrize(PoolId poolId). Randomness comes from recent block data, acceptable only for small pots and stated in the README. Expose pot(PoolId poolId) and nextDrawAt(PoolId poolId) as views. {@walletLimit} {@feeBasis}

anyone.label: Run the draw when the period is over

blocks.risk: The draw uses block data for randomness. A well-funded player can tilt the odds. Keep pots small and say so on your token’s page.
blocks.who: Runs itself; anyone presses the button when the period ends.

blocks.title: Custom rule
blocks.blurb: One rule in your own words.
blocks.sentence: {text:clean}
blocks.who: Whatever your sentence says. Your launch’s own audit covers it.
blocks.risk: Written rules are riskier than blocks. If the builder has to stop and ask a question after you pay, the 0.5 IMD is spent. Blocks are checked sentences; words are yours.
